intro: One piece of original fast food fried chicken is an estimated 320 kcal. Most of the calories come from the floured skin and frying oil.
diet: Yes, fried chicken is high in protein. But calories climb fast when you eat 3-4 pieces with rice, fries and a sweet drink. One or two pieces with coleslaw or veg is still okay. The skin is the highest-fat part.
tips: Choose a drumstick if you want fewer calories.
Remove half the skin to cut down on fat.
Pair it with a small coleslaw or corn, not large fries.

swap.name: Original fried chicken, skin removed
swap.why: You keep the protein, but cut a lot of fat from the flour and oil.

faq.q: Which chicken part has the most protein?
faq.a: The breast has the most protein and is also the biggest piece.

faq.q: Original vs hot & spicy, what's the difference?
faq.a: Hot & spicy has a thicker, spicier coating. Original is thinner and seasoned with herbs and spices.
Yes, use an air fryer or oven so the skin gets crispy again. The microwave will make the skin soggy.
